description: State-specific model experiments for e_y, e_psi, v, theta
note: v9 retrained from scratch with seed=43. Primary differs from protocol because protocol uses original v9 checkpoint which had accidental regularization bugs.

results_summary.h100_nmae: per_state data available in full log

results_summary.note: GP has very low target@H100 but high primary score due to poor long-horizon stability

e_psi.status: INCOMPLETE - experiment was terminated during GP training for e_psi

key_findings.e_y: NODE wide (128 hidden, 4 layers, tanh) is the best architecture for e_y with +9.2% improvement over v9 baseline. Standard NODE performs worse (-49.2%). GP has lowest single-step error but poor long-horizon stability. Linear is competitive with v9.
key_findings.general: State-specific specialization shows promise for e_y with wider architecture. The monolithic v9 architecture remains competitive for other states due to cross-state coupling.

recommendations: Complete e_psi, v, theta experiments with NODE and node_wide architectures only (skip GP for speed)
GP shows interesting single-step precision but poor rollout stability - investigate why
node_wide (128 hidden, 4 layers) outperforms standard node (64 hidden, 3 layers) for e_y
Consider ensemble of node_wide for e_y with v9 for other states
